rationale: The same CSIS figure (14,700+ one-way attack drones from September 2022 to end-2024, about 90% shot down) was extracted twice in topic 01.
Both give RUSI's 40,000 UMPK kits produced in 2024.
B's Iskander-M output rising from 6 a month in 2022 includes A's RUSI estimate.
B's series includes the same 435 km² claimed by Zelensky on 8 March 2026.
Both give RUSI's 40,000 UMPK kits produced in 2024, from the same report.
The General Staff's 1,531,060 Russian killed and wounded by late September 2026 is close to UK intelligence's about 1.5 million casualties.
Both give the 7th Corps' 20–25 km kill zone on the Pokrovsk axis in July 2026, from the same source.
Zelensky's 745 km² by 12 August 2026 is the end point of A's series of claims.
Both describe Ukrainian troops held on position for more than a month, citing RUSI.
The two point values are for different actions (a kill versus a confirmed self-destruction) and do not bear on each other.
The same Radio Svoboda figure of 27 km² for July 2026 was extracted in topic 07 and topic 04; B also notes DeepState's 36 km².
HUR's figure of more than 100,000 UMPK a year is consistent with the 2025 plans of 70,000–120,000 in A.
The same United24 figure (jet-drone launches from about 350 in June to about 2,800 in August 2026) was extracted twice in topic 01.
A places anti-drone nets 15–30 km from the front; B is Brovdi's kill-zone depth. They are related context, not the same quantity.
Both state the same comparison (corps' 125 km² versus mappers' 200–240 km² for Vivaldi) from overlapping sources in topic 05.
B adds ISW's lower reading (two windows totalling up to 90 minutes) to A's Euromaidan figure of two windows of more than an hour each.
B's description of the 20–200 km middle-strike campaign against convoys and the M-14 route to Crimea corroborates A, with a shared Kyiv Independent source.
Both give Shipovnik-Aero's range of about 10 km from the same Euromaidan source.
Both give the Army of Drones' 7,000+ operators trained in the first nine months, from the same source.
The same Kyiv Post Excalibur figures (55% to 6% in 2023) were extracted twice in topic 02.
The same ISIS May 2026 record of 8,161 Shahed-type launches was extracted twice in topic 01.
Both give Zemledeliye's 5–15 km range from the same Euromaidan source.
The same Siverskyi Donets length (1,053 km, about 950 km in Ukraine) was re-extracted as a key figure in topic 06.
Zelensky's 'up to 100 a day' in 2024 is the source of B's 2024 KAB rate of about 100 a day.
The same sentence from the same Militarnyi source was extracted twice in topic 02.
The same Ukrainian intelligence claim (a mobilization contingency of 300,000 a year for 2026–27) was extracted twice in topic 04; B has more sources.
B's compiled series begins with the same 409+ launches for September–December 2022 from the same dataset.
The same DeepState figure of 36 km² for July 2026, from the same Kyiv Post report, was extracted in topic 07 and topic 04.
B's Lasiichuk statement includes A's expectation of 30 km by the end of 2026.
Air Force totals of about 54,800 (2025) versus about 11,100 (2024) corroborate CSIS's over 50,000, about five times the previous year.
Kluge's series gives the same 71,216 for Q1 2026, the lowest of the three Q1 values, as B.
The same 3rd Corps account (UGVs dropped by heavy bombers onto mapped command nodes more than 10 km deep) was extracted in topic 03 and topic 05; B has more sources.
B's FPRI growth figure ends at the same approximately 5,000 in spring 2026 as A.
CSIS's 50,000+ Shaheds in 2025 matches ISIS's over 50,000 Shahed-type drones; both are ultimately based on Ukrainian Air Force counts.
B's named-dead figure is a hard lower bound, compatible with CSIS's 275,000–325,000 killed estimate.
B's series starts with the same MoD figure of 67 units using UGVs in November 2025.
B's key figure cites the same DeepState end-2025 total of about 116,000 km².
B includes the same expectation of a 30 km kill zone that A attributes to the 7th Corps commander.
The same RUSI figure (fibre FPV range about 10 km, February 2025) was extracted twice in topic 02.
B gives the gross breakdown and the grey zone behind the same computed May 2026 net of +14 km².
